proof_summary: A pair-word encoding of the run-length dynamics and its exact renormalization yield linear recurrences for auxiliary counts, from which one obtains the quasi-submultiplicative bound \(p_{m+n}\le 16p_mp_n\) and the comparison \(2p_{n-11}\le a_n\le17664p_{n-11}\). Fekete’s lemma then gives convergence of \(\log p_n/n\); the comparison squeezes \(\log a_n/n\) to the same limit, and exponentiation proves convergence of the nth roots.
